dogecoin.text:
#BTC (#Bitcoin) as a store of value
#LTC (#Litecoin) for small (or big) transactions
#DOGE #Dogecoin) for really small transactions

It's been said before, but now it's getting more real every hour.
So, clearly, I stand corrected: for small payments (below € 100): use #dogecoin !

On friday, I had no cash with me so I asked a friend to pay for me at the #Bitcoin meeting we attended. (They did not accept #crypto!) He paid € 5. I paid him back using #Litecoin. Transaction cost: € 0.24. Today, I tested #dogecoin #doge for this transaction. Cost: € 0.007.

@Ledger Ledger Manager does not list Zcash atm. I cannot uninstall it. So I cannot uninstall Bitcoin. So I cannot update Bitcoin. Therefore, I cannot install Dogecoin. Why this ridiculous list of dependencies? Why can't I just DELETE Zcash?
